camel_example: aliyun alikafka CreateScheduledScalingRule --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleType at --ReservedPubFlow 120 --ReservedSubFlow 120 --TimeZone 'GMT+8' --InstanceId 'alikafka_serverless-cn-vxxxxxxxx' --DurationMinutes 60 --FirstScheduledTime 1714467540000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RuleName test
description_en: Creates a scheduled elastic scaling policy for a serverless instance after deployment
description_zh: Serverless 系列实例部署后，允许通过该接口创建实例弹性定时策略配置
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka create-scheduled-scaling-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_serverless-cn-vxxxxxxxx --rule-name test --reserved-pub-flow 120 --reserved-sub-flow 120 --schedule-type at --duration-minutes 60 --time-zone GMT+8 --first-scheduled-time 1714467540000 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateScheduledScalingRule

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scheduled policy rule.

The name must be unique among all rules of the same instance
parameters.help_zh:
定时策略规则名称。

不可以与同实例其他规则名称重复
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The reserved production specification for scheduled elastic scaling (unit: MB/s).

At least one of ReservedPubFlow and ReservedSubFlow must be higher than the current specification
parameters.help_zh:
定时弹性预留生产规格（单位：MB/s）。

ReservedPubFlow 和 ReservedSubFlow 入参必须至少有一个高于当前规格
parameters.name: reserved_pub_flow

parameters.help_en:
The reserved consumption specification for scheduled elastic scaling (unit: MB/s).
At least one of ReservedSubFlow and ReservedPubFlow must be higher than the current specification
parameters.help_zh:
定时弹性预留消费规格（单位：MB/s）。
ReservedSubFlow 和 ReservedPubFlow 入参必须至少有一个高于当前规格
parameters.name: reserved_sub_flow

parameters.help_en:
The schedule type. Valid values:

at: scheduled once only.

repeat: scheduled repeatedly
parameters.help_zh:
定时类型。取值如下：

at ：只调度一次。

repeat：重复调度
parameters.name: schedule_type

parameters.help_en:
The duration (unit: minutes) of a single scheduled elastic scaling task.

The value must be at least 15 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
持续时间（单位：分钟），一次定时弹性任务持续的时间。

入参不少于15分钟
parameters.name: duration_minutes

parameters.help_en:
The time when the scheduled policy starts to take effect.

If the schedule type is single execution, the start time must be at least 30 minutes later than the current time.



<notice>To prevent the server from continuously performing scale-up and scale-down tasks, the interval between different scheduled tasks must be at least 60 minutes.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时策略时间。

如果是单次调度的策略类型，需要保证开始执行时间晚于当前时间30分钟以上。



<notice>为避免服务端不停地执行升配、降配任务，不同定时任务之间的时间间隔要至少大于 60 分钟。></notice>
parameters.name: first_scheduled_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the scheduled policy. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用定时任务策略。取值范围如下：

true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en:
The repeat type. This parameter is required when ScheduleType is set to repeat. Valid values:
      <li> Daily: timed scheduling every day.
      <li> Weekly: timed scheduling every week
parameters.help_zh:
当 ScheduleType 为 repeat 时则需要填写参数，枚举值为
      <li> Daily：每天定时调度。
      <li> Weekly：每周定时调度
parameters.name: repeat_type

parameters.help_en: The days of the week. Multiple days are supported for repeated execution
parameters.help_zh: 每周的类型。支持多日重复执行
parameters.name: weekly_types

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
